sourceCheckoutEnvelope.qualification: Conservative entire AI_HLY/Packages plus installer bootstrap and two native helpers; excludes generated native assets, Git/index/compiler overhead and future unknown source changes; no symlink target followed

unknownUntilAssignedArchive.C: Sum of18 compressed native payload files plus catalog extracted from outer ZIP
unknownUntilAssignedArchive.N: Sum of all18 installed expanded payloads, with filesystem block/directory/symlink overhead
unknownUntilAssignedArchive.M: Largest compressed payload size; publisher readback temporary upper payload

extractionStrategy: Inspect nested central directories directly through ZipFile.open before full payload extraction; outer is uploaded with compression-level0. Keep original outer ZIP and original prepared catalog. Extract inner archives only; never pre-expand all frameworks separately.
nativeInstallStrategy: Original installer extracts one archive into a temporary directory under the destination SDK, validates it, then renames into final path. For a fresh destination, final installed files plus current temporary files fit within N, apart from directory/bookkeeping overhead; no second N tree.
cacheStrategy: Hardlink authenticated prepared compressed archives into the exact owned checksum-archive cache names on the same/mnt filesystem. Cache contributes directory entries, not a second C allocation. Published URL readback remains mandatory and independent.

workspacePhaseBudgets.publication: Z+C+thin producer-source checkout/receipts on/mnt; maxM on/tmp
workspacePhaseBudgets.full44Installation: Z+C+S+N+G on/mnt, plus original Node source validation temporary607496 payload bytes on/tmp; S is measured final source checkout
workspacePhaseBudgets.selectedHostAdoption: Existing source-only Host descendants are updated in place after final freeze; do not multiply N by three

mandatoryAll18Together: YES in final installed full44 closure; NO second complete pre-expanded18 staging tree
sizeAdmission: NOT_RUN until exact eligible prepared ZIP is assigned; prior failed-run184MB outer ZIP is only historical reference, never the size of this producer
additionalCleanup: Inventory only; explicit root disposition required; no files removed in this prerequisite task
